one_line: A grooming guide matching beard styles to round, square, and oval face shapes using Indian celebrities as visual examples.

hook.what_happens: Kapil Sharma's face is shown with a 'Round face' label and a dotted outline, explaining how to make it look longer.
hook.why_it_works: Uses a highly recognizable celebrity and immediate visual categorization to hook the viewer.

shots.description: Kapil Sharma demonstrates round face beard styles with dynamic overlays showing recommended and avoided cuts.
Yash demonstrates square face beard styles, showing how to soften a wide jawline.
Ranbir Kapoor demonstrates oval face beard styles, highlighting versatility and balance.
B-roll of Yash with a full beard and sunglasses, transitioning to the final call to action.

devices.used_for: Defining the geometric face shape of the subject.

devices.name: Beard Shading Overlay
devices.what_it_is: Semi-transparent textured overlay on the jawline.
devices.used_for: Visualizing different beard shapes on the same face.

devices.name: Status Chips
devices.what_it_is: Pill-shaped labels with green checkmarks or red cross marks.

transcript.text: If you have a round shaped face, your beard should make your face look longer by being shorter on the sides.
So go for a tapered beard, a ducktail, or a thick boxed beard.
But skip a big full beard or a lot of hair around your cheeks.
If you have a square shaped face, your jaw is already wide, so your beard needs to soften your jaw.
So go for a beardstache, a short tapered beard, a balbo, or a long boxed beard.
But avoid a very thick full beard.
And if you have an oval shaped face, you have the most freedom because your face is already balanced.
So go for a stubble, beardstache, full beard, Van Dyke, but mainly skip extreme versions.

narrative_arc: Identify round face shape and recommend styles to elongate it.
Identify square face shape and recommend styles to soften the jaw.
Identify oval face shape and highlight its versatility.
Call to action to follow for more tips.
what_makes_it_work: Uses famous Indian celebrities to make the advice highly relatable.
Dynamic visual overlays show beard styles changing instantly on the same face.
Clear, binary categorization (do's and don'ts) simplifies decision-making.

animations.name: Contour Draw (Face Shape)
animations.what_moves: A dotted white line tracing the contour of the model's face.
animations.purpose: To visually define and highlight the specific face shape (round, square, oval) being discussed.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting any region of interest, silhouette, or boundary on a subject or product.

animations.name: Beard Mesh Overlay
animations.what_moves: A shaded dotted grid overlaying the beard area.
animations.purpose: To isolate and draw focus to the beard zone of the face before showing style variations.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting specific zones or features on a product, face, or body part for analysis.

animations.name: Dimension Lines & Arrows
animations.what_moves: Vertical lines and horizontal arrows indicating face proportions.
animations.purpose: To illustrate geometric grooming advice, such as making the face look longer or keeping sides shorter.
animations.reusable_as: Showing dimensions, fits, adjustments, or focal points on a diagram or photo.

animations.name: Tag/Pill PopIn
animations.what_moves: Green checkmark or red cross recommendation pills.
animations.purpose: To clearly label a beard style as recommended (green check) or to be avoided (red cross).
animations.reusable_as: Displaying pros/cons, feature tags, or dos/don'ts on any product or comparison video.

animations.name: Beard Style Montage
animations.what_moves: The beard style on the model's face changes instantly.
animations.purpose: To show how different beard styles look on the same face shape in rapid succession.
animations.reusable_as: Swapping hairstyles, glasses, clothing, makeup, or accessories on a model.

signature_moves: Beard Style Montage for rapid visual swaps
animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Face contours draw on smoothly, while recommendation pills pop in with an elastic scale-up.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements generally fade out or are replaced abruptly by the next scene's elements.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Hard cuts between different models representing different face shapes.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The model's face and the background remain perfectly static to maintain alignment during beard swaps.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Bursty and educational, with rapid-fire beard swaps and tag pop-ins matching the voiceover's pace.

what_we_should_steal: The seamless Beard Style Montage swap on a static model face to show instant variations.
The Contour Draw tracing face shapes to immediately establish the visual context of the advice.
